Name: Cute scarecrows
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]Cute Scarecrows[/b]
Gives your scarecrows a lovely makeover with [b]three selectable styles[/b]!
Choose your favorite design from the mod configuration menu and customize your farm’s look.

[b][u]Styles[/u][/b]
• [b]Vanilla Style[/b] – Classic scarecrows redesigned in a softer and prettier version of the originals.
• [b]Cute Style[/b] – Humanized versions inspired by each vanilla scarecrow’s theme,
 featuring different outfits while keeping their recognizable colors.
• [b]Simple Style[/b] – A minimalist take:
 all scarecrows share the same base design, recolored according to their vanilla counterpart.
